name: 76252 · Muenster, TX
findings: ZIP 76252 (Muenster) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76252 (Muenster) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
